verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training opt-out is a fair question for terminal emulators, since some terminals ship cloud or AI features with data policies, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack covers kitty's data collection, telemetry, or any AI-training policy or opt-out. The one community remark about unspecified 'privacy and security' issues says nothing about AI training, so it is not credited either way.
